objective: Compare all four current PSR partitions with literal P/X population terms and with the ten population wildcards accepted for the main route.

controls.protocol_date_scope: source inception through the 2026-08-29 diagnostic cutoff year
controls.editions: all currently exposed Core Collection editions

application.PSR1: replace the P members nested in X
application.PSR2: replace the P members nested in X
application.PSR4: replace the P members nested in X

wildcard_candidate.x_additions: keep every supporting-protocol X addition literal

acceptance_checks: All eight literal and wildcard events complete strict two-pass WOS-ID and total reconciliation.
Each successful event retains its configured-search and first-results screenshots.
Each wildcard partition retains every WOS ID from its literal counterpart.
Every wildcard-only record receives a population-scope review before acceptance.
The complete successful query union retrieves Buruso et al. when the source indexes it.
No language, type, subject, access, controlled-term, proximity, or pair restriction is used.
acceptance_rule: Accept the ten population wildcards for PSR only if all literal IDs are retained and every wildcard-only record remains within the declared P meaning.
